nodes.title: NF-01 Component Families Contract
nodes.detail: Defines the 6 canonical families (field, input, checkbox, radio, table-row, table-cell), declared TEXT/BOOLEAN/INSTANCE_SWAP properties, sibling preservation, and sample-only defaults.

nodes.title: Canonical Form Family Mapping & Accessibility Correspondence
nodes.detail: Field, input, checkbox, and radio families compose via INSTANCE_SWAP, preserve independent sibling overrides, leave undeclared action-button controls untouched, and map dom_source to real label-for/fieldset/keyboard controls.

nodes.title: TableRow Slot Composition & Semantic Table Semantics
nodes.detail: table-row composes named table-cell INSTANCE_SWAP slots without combinatorial column variants and binds caption and th scope semantics in HTML.
